The '''flow-mollusk''' was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. The shelled [[Mollusk/Legends|mollusk]] at one point lived in the planet's shallow [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]],<ref name="TEA" /> and for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]],<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> Eriadu was known for its delicate shellwork jewelry. Around [[900 BBY/Legends|900 BBY]], however, the five powerful and ambitious [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] families known as the [[Quintad/Legends|Quintad]] migrated to the planet and sought to transform it into a [[Factory world/Legends|manufacturing world]]. As a result, Eriadu became heavily polluted, and increased ocean [[Acid/Legends|acidity]] led to the flow-mollusk shells dissolving and the creatures becoming extinct.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The flow-mollusk was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
